skills.name: outline-first-deck
skills.title: Outline-first deck
skills.summary: Drafts a sourced slide outline, waits for approval, then builds the deck.
skills.complements: Create a presentation from a file (Narrative builder): adds a human approval gate and per-slide sources
triggers: Draft a 10-slide deck from the attached project brief
Turn these notes into a presentation for the leadership team
Start a deck on our Q4 hiring plan, outline first

skills.name: executive-summary-slide
skills.title: Executive summary slide
skills.summary: Adds one approved summary slide of three to five conclusions, each traced to its source slide.
skills.complements: Review this presentation: produces the summary slide itself, with traceability
triggers: Add an executive summary slide to this deck
Give me a one-slide recap for the board
Write a TL;DR slide after the title

skills.name: action-title-rewrite
skills.title: Action title rewrite
skills.summary: Proposes full-sentence action titles and a storyline check, applied only after approval.
skills.complements: Rewrite: works on the title layer and the storyline, not body text
triggers: Sharpen the slide titles so the deck tells a story
Apply one message per slide to these titles
Read me the storyline from the titles only

skills.name: numbers-and-claims-check
skills.title: Numbers and claims check
skills.summary: Registers every figure and claim with its source and flags unsourced or inconsistent items. Never edits a figure.
skills.complements: Review this presentation and Prepare for Questions: adds a traceability audit
triggers: Fact-check the numbers in this deck before Monday
Which claims in this presentation have no source?
Check these figures against the attached report

skills.name: brand-rules-check
skills.title: Brand rules check
skills.summary: Checks each slide against a written brand rules file and reports PASS, FIX PROPOSED or MANUAL CHECK.
skills.complements: Brand Kit: an auditable written report that also works where Brand Kit is not set up
triggers: Is this deck on brand?
Check these slides against our brand guidelines
Find anything off-template before this goes to the client

skills.name: decision-slide
skills.title: Decision slide
skills.summary: Builds a DRAFT options, criteria and recommendation slide with a named decision owner and a blank outcome.
skills.complements: Prepare for Questions: turns the debate into an explicit decision request
triggers: Make a decision slide for the vendor choice
I need the steering committee to choose between these three options
Add a recommendation slide with the ask

skills.name: accessibility-pass
skills.title: Accessibility pass
skills.summary: Finds accessibility issues, drafts alt text and fixes, and applies only what the owner approves.
skills.complements: The application's accessibility checker: adds drafted alt text, jargon and colour-only checks
triggers: Make this deck accessible
Add alt text to every image
Check this presentation for screen reader users

skills.name: steering-committee-status-deck
skills.title: Steering committee status deck
skills.summary: Builds a DRAFT five to seven slide status pack with proposed RAG statuses the user confirms.
skills.complements: None directly: assembles a governed status pack from existing reports
triggers: Build this month's steering committee deck from the status report
Turn the RAID log and plan into board slides
Make the programme update pack for Thursday

skills.name: workbook-structure-audit
skills.title: Workbook structure audit
skills.summary: Maps every sheet including hidden ones, named ranges, external links, filters and protection. Changes nothing.
skills.complements: None directly: describes the container rather than the calculations
triggers: What is actually in this workbook?
I inherited this file, map it for me
Are there hidden sheets or external links in here?

skills.name: formula-risk-review
skills.title: Formula risk review
skills.summary: Finds the formula faults that return a plausible wrong number instead of an error. Edits no formula.
skills.complements: Complements check-model: works on any workbook, reports only, never edits
triggers: Review the formulas in this model before I send it
Are there any hardcoded numbers inside these formulas?
Check the sum ranges cover the whole block

skills.name: lookup-integrity-check
skills.title: Lookup integrity check
skills.summary: Checks every lookup for approximate match, duplicate keys, unmatched keys and type mismatches. Changes nothing.
skills.complements: Complements clean-data: examines the joins rather than the values
triggers: Why do these two sheets disagree?
Check my lookups for duplicate keys
Which keys are missing from the mapping table?

skills.name: data-quality-sweep
skills.title: Data quality sweep
skills.summary: Profiles a table and reports mixed types, text numbers, duplicates, category variants and blanks. Corrects nothing.
skills.complements: Complements clean-data: reports and quantifies rather than cleaning
triggers: Check the quality of this dataset before I pivot it
Why is my pivot splitting the same category in two?
Profile these columns and tell me what is wrong

skills.name: reconciliation-check
skills.title: Reconciliation check
skills.summary: Re-adds every stated total from its components and reports each line that does not tie, with both values. Never edits a number.
skills.complements: Complements check-model: ties out any workbook, not only financial models, and never edits
triggers: Does this pack tie out?
Re-add these totals and show me what breaks
Check the summary agrees with the detail sheets

skills.name: units-and-rounding-check
skills.title: Units and rounding check
skills.summary: Finds thousands mixed with millions, multiple currencies summed together and display rounding that hides a real break.
skills.complements: Complements number formatting: reads units as meaning, not as formatting
triggers: Why is this total one out?
Check the units are consistent across these sheets
Are we mixing currencies anywhere in this model?

skills.name: assumptions-register
skills.title: Assumptions register
skills.summary: Lists every input with its cell, value, unit, period and stated source, including constants buried inside formulas.
skills.complements: Complements a documentation sheet: built from the model rather than maintained beside it
triggers: What does this model assume?
Build me an assumptions list from this workbook
Find the rates hardcoded inside the formulas

skills.name: model-map
skills.title: Model map
skills.summary: Traces the calculation chain behind one output cell back to its inputs, and flags typed overrides in the middle.
skills.complements: Complements check-model: traces one output cell on any workbook, reports only
triggers: How is this number calculated?
Trace this total back to its inputs
What would change if I moved this assumption?

skills.name: variance-explainer
skills.title: Variance explainer
skills.summary: Splits a movement into the drivers the data supports and reports the remainder as unexplained. Invents no driver.
skills.complements: None directly: refuses to force the bridge to tie
triggers: Why did this move between the two periods?
Bridge plan to actual for me
Explain this variance and show what is unexplained

skills.name: chart-intent-check
skills.title: Chart intent check
skills.summary: Checks each chart against what its title claims: truncated axes, inconsistent scales, dual axes and unexplained colour.
skills.complements: Complements chart-design: reviews what a reader could wrongly conclude
triggers: Check these charts before they go in the pack
Is this axis misleading?
Are these two charts comparable?

skills.name: scenario-skeleton
skills.title: Scenario skeleton
skills.summary: Builds a base, downside and upside scaffold wired to a case switch, and leaves every scenario value blank.
skills.complements: Complements what-if analysis: builds the frame and refuses to invent the cases
triggers: Add scenarios to this model
Set up a downside and upside case
Wire these inputs to a scenario switch

skills.name: workbook-handover-note
skills.title: Workbook handover note
skills.summary: Drafts the read me the file never had, with UNKNOWN left visible wherever the workbook does not say.
skills.complements: Complements a documentation sheet: records what the file evidences and marks the gaps
triggers: Write a handover note for this model
I am leaving, document this workbook
What would someone need to know to pick this up?

skills.name: speaker-notes-builder
skills.title: Speaker notes builder
skills.summary: Drafts a talk track per slide, marks where a note would need a fact the deck lacks, and flags notes that contradict their slide.
skills.complements: Complements Agent mode speaker notes: adds gap markers, a contradiction check and timing
triggers: Write speaker notes for this deck
Give me a talk track for a 20 minute slot
Do my existing notes contradict the slides?

skills.name: deck-trim-proposal
skills.title: Deck trim proposal
skills.summary: Proposes what to cut, merge or move so a deck fits its slot, naming what is lost in each case. Deletes nothing.
skills.complements: Complements Review this presentation: proposes against the argument, not against taste
triggers: This deck is too long, what can go?
Cut this to 15 slides
Which slides repeat each other?

skills.name: deck-consistency-sweep
skills.title: Deck consistency sweep
skills.summary: Finds terms used two ways, unexpanded acronyms, mixed date and number formats and renamed products across the whole deck.
skills.complements: Complements Rewrite: works across the deck where a slide by slide read cannot
triggers: Proofread this deck for consistency
Is our product named the same way throughout?
Which acronyms are never expanded?

skills.name: appendix-split
skills.title: Appendix split
skills.summary: Separates the presented argument from its supporting detail, leaving a pointer on every slide that lost support.
skills.complements: Complements deck-trim-proposal: relocates rather than cuts
triggers: Move the detail to an appendix
Split this into a main deck and back-up
Make this work as a walkthrough and as a document
